subtitle: Per-symbol coverage of the C++ <iterator> header. Tags, iterator_traits, stepping (advance/distance/next/prev), 11 range-access free functions, and 5 non-stream adaptors. Stream iterators await <iostream>.
legend_blurb: Per-symbol coverage of the C++ <iterator> header. Tags, iterator_traits, stepping, range access, and the 5 non-stream adaptors shipped in Phases 7a + 7b (2026-05-08/09). Stream iterators await <iostream>; common/counted_iterator await <ranges>.

symbols.name: input_iterator_tag
symbols.notes: Empty struct for tag dispatch. Restd tag is structurally distinct from std; iterator_traits primary translates std tags to restd via is_base_of cascade.

symbols.name: output_iterator_tag
symbols.notes: Independent tag (does NOT derive from input_iterator_tag); matches the std hierarchy convention.

symbols.name: forward_iterator_tag
symbols.notes: Derives from input_iterator_tag.

symbols.name: bidirectional_iterator_tag
symbols.notes: Derives from forward_iterator_tag.

symbols.name: random_access_iterator_tag
symbols.notes: Derives from bidirectional_iterator_tag. Raw pointers carry this tag through iterator_traits<T*>.

symbols.name: contiguous_iterator_tag
symbols.notes: Derives from random_access_iterator_tag. Raw pointers carry this via iterator_concept on C++20+ (in addition to the random_access iterator_category).

symbols.name: iterator_traits
symbols.notes: Detection-based primary template (matches C++17+ std behaviour: empty when It does not expose all five member typedefs). Std-to-restd tag translation in primary via std::is_base_of cascade; raw-pointer specialisations defined directly. iterator_concept (C++20+) on raw pointers only — user-defined iterators flow through iterator_category translation. Currently leaks <iterator> + <type_traits> dependencies into restd; documented as localised, justified.
symbols.failure_reason: C++98 path not yet shipped — uses void_t (C++11). The detection-based primary requires SFINAE machinery that the C++98 path can be retrofitted to provide via a tag-type approach when needed.

symbols.name: advance
symbols.notes: Tag-dispatched on iterator_category: O(1) random_access (+=), O(|n|) bidirectional (with negative-n support), O(n) input/forward (positive-only).

symbols.name: distance
symbols.notes: Tag-dispatched: O(1) for random_access, O(distance) otherwise.

symbols.name: next
symbols.notes: Returns it advanced by n (default 1). Built on advance().

symbols.name: prev
symbols.notes: Returns it stepped backward by n (default 1). advance(-n) under the hood.

symbols.name: begin
symbols.notes: Four overload categories: container& / const container& (member begin), T(&)[N] (raw arrays), and initializer_list.

symbols.name: end
symbols.notes: Mirrors begin.

symbols.name: cbegin
symbols.notes: Forces const path of begin. Always yields const_iterator (or const T* on arrays).

symbols.name: cend
symbols.notes: Pairs with cbegin.

symbols.name: rbegin
symbols.notes: For containers, forwards member rbegin. For arrays/initializer_list, wraps end()/il.end() in restd::reverse_iterator.

symbols.name: rend
symbols.notes: Pairs with rbegin.

symbols.name: crbegin
symbols.notes: Forces const path of rbegin.

symbols.name: crend
symbols.notes: Pairs with crbegin.

symbols.name: size
symbols.notes: Forwards member size for containers; returns N for raw arrays. Std ssize (signed-size variant, C++20) not yet implemented.

symbols.name: empty
symbols.notes: Forwards member empty for containers; returns false for raw arrays (zero-extent is ill-formed); checks .size() == 0 for initializer_list.

symbols.name: data
symbols.notes: Forwards member data; pointer-to-first for arrays; il.begin() for initializer_list. Caller is responsible for the contiguity precondition.

symbols.name: reverse_iterator
symbols.notes: Off-by-one: base() points one past the dereferenced element. Mutating ops (op++, op*, op->, op+=, op[]) are constexpr only on C++14+ via local D_CONSTEXPR_CPP14 macro. operator-> uses & on the dereference for non-pointer iterators (no addressof — would create a <memory> dependency). Std uses addressof in the reference branch; restd matches std for raw pointers and most class iterators with operator->().
symbols.failure_reason: C++98 path planned but not yet shipped; would need a non-constexpr variant and copy-based ctors.

symbols.name: make_reverse_iterator
symbols.notes: Trivial wrapper.

symbols.name: move_iterator
symbols.notes: reference type chosen via internal::move_reference_of: on T& base it yields T&& (xvalue), on by-value base (proxy iterator) it yields T unchanged. Matches the C++17+ std contract; pre-C++17 std had a worse contract that broke proxies — restd does NOT reproduce that. iterator_concept = input_iterator_tag on C++20+. operator-> kept on every tier (deprecated C++20, removed C++23 in std).

symbols.name: make_move_iterator
symbols.notes: Trivial wrapper.

symbols.name: back_insert_iterator
symbols.notes: Output-only iterator. operator= calls container.push_back(value); ++ is a no-op; * returns *this. Two assignment overloads (const T& and T&&) for move-friendly insertion.
symbols.failure_reason: C++98 path planned but not yet shipped; the rvalue overload is gated on C++11+. The const-ref-only form would back-port to C++98 directly.

symbols.name: back_inserter
symbols.notes: Trivial wrapper.

symbols.name: front_insert_iterator
symbols.notes: Like back_insert_iterator but calls push_front. NOTE: copying [first, last) into a front_insert_iterator REVERSES the order in the destination — each element pushed becomes the new front.
symbols.failure_reason: C++98 path planned but not yet shipped (rvalue overload).

symbols.name: front_inserter
symbols.notes: Trivial wrapper.

symbols.name: insert_iterator
symbols.notes: Tracks position via iter = container->insert(iter, v); ++iter. PRESERVES source order (unlike front_inserter). Works correctly even when the underlying container invalidates iterators on insert.
symbols.failure_reason: C++98 path planned but not yet shipped (rvalue overload).

symbols.name: inserter
symbols.notes: Trivial wrapper. Takes a hint iterator.

symbols.name: istream_iterator
symbols.notes: Reads values from an input stream until EOF.

symbols.name: ostream_iterator
symbols.notes: Writes values to an output stream, optionally interleaved with a separator.

symbols.name: istreambuf_iterator
symbols.notes: Lower-level than istream_iterator; reads characters from a streambuf.

symbols.name: ostreambuf_iterator
symbols.notes: Lower-level than ostream_iterator.

symbols.name: common_iterator
symbols.notes: Wraps an iterator/sentinel pair into something with iterator_category (for legacy algorithm interop).
symbols.failure_reason: Out of scope until restd::<concepts> + ranges machinery is in place.

symbols.name: counted_iterator
symbols.notes: Wraps an iterator with a remaining-count to enable take_view-style ranges.

symbols.name: iter_move
symbols.notes: Customisation point object (niebloid) shipped Phase R22. Two-stage dispatch via priority<N> hierarchy: ADL iter_move(it) for user customisations, else static_cast<rvalue-ref>(*it) as the default fallback. Poison-pill iter_move() = delete forces ADL discovery. Inline-constexpr instance on C++17+, static-constexpr on C++11/14.

symbols.name: iter_rvalue_reference_t
symbols.notes: Alias for decltype(restd::iter_move(declval<I&>())). Shipped Phase R22 alongside the iter_move CPO.
symbols.failure_reason: Alias template depending on iter_move CPO.

symbols.name: basic_const_iterator
symbols.notes: Wraps an iterator I and presents its dereference as a const reference. Full iterator surface (forward/bidi/RA ops) with const-projection via const_ref_projection helper mapping T& → const T&, T&& → const T&&, T → T. Cross-type ==/!= against arbitrary sentinel types so it works in non-common ranges without partial specialisation. Shipped Phase R22; powers as_const_view (R22 rewrite) and the cbegin/cend/crbegin/crend CPOs (R24).

symbols.name: iter_const_reference_t
symbols.notes: Alias yielding the const-projected reference type for an iterator. Shipped Phase R22 alongside basic_const_iterator.

symbols.name: iter_concept (member typedef pull-through)
symbols.notes: Optional iterator_concept on user-defined class iterators is currently NOT pulled through iterator_traits's primary translation; only iterator_category translates. Raw-pointer specs do define iterator_concept = contiguous_iterator_tag on C++20+. A class iterator with iterator_concept = std::contiguous_iterator_tag and iterator_category = std::random_access_iterator_tag will translate to restd::random_access (most-specific by category alone).
symbols.failure_reason: Mechanical to add: extend the iter_traits_impl partial spec to detect iterator_concept and translate alongside iterator_category, with the more-specific of the two winning. Slated for a follow-up.

symbols.name: iterator (base class template)
symbols.notes: Removed in C++20. restd intentionally does NOT ship this base class — modern user iterators expose member typedefs directly.
symbols.failure_reason: Intentionally not implemented. Code using std::iterator should be ported to declare typedefs directly.
